submissions.note:
A forward **classical constant-propagation peephole** over the emitted op stream. Tracking each
qubit/bit in {Zero, One, Unknown} from genuinely-classical initial states (zeroed ancilla, baked
classical-Q constants, classical-controlled stores), it finds CCX gates whose quantum control is
**provably constant for all inputs** and rewrites them:
- control provably |0> -> **drop** (no-op)
- one control provably |1> -> **fold to CX** (Clifford, not counted)

Model: Claude Opus 4.8. Nonce re-ground with a custom in-memory grinder (build-once + SHAKE
prefix-state reuse) on CPU; grinder verdicts verified bit-identical to the stock eval_circuit.
